role: The splash when a water drop lands: a rain particle with lower gravity and a texture index bump.

members.name: EntitySplashFX
members.note: EntityRainFX's constructor, gravity 0.04, the next texture, and the motion from the arguments when vy is 0 and vx or vz is not

notes: Ported in csrc/engine/particles_live.c (constructor new_splash, onUpdate in fx_update, getBrightnessForRender in fx_brf) and drawn by csrc/engine/raster_particles.c (draw_list, render_scale for the scale renderParticle animates). test_rendertick replays each recorded tick natively and compares every FX field bit for bit with the next frame row (lane/particles2). fx_client: 39 splashes from the player's entry into water. lane/idxlast 2026-09-27: proven by the rendertick scene fx_client (seed 1, --particles 0, 143 ticks, 3,923 FX compared field by field against the oracle's dump, test_rendertick); it fails with the class changed (a negative control of 80 mismatches).
